title: What is Fine-tuning?
description: Fine-tuning keeps training a ready model on focused examples for one task or style. What changes, what it costs, prompting vs tuning.
lead: Fine-tuning takes a pretrained model and keeps training it on a smaller, carefully chosen set of examples. The base capabilities stay, while responses bend toward the new material: steadier formatting, domain vocabulary, and fewer reminders of the general task. It trades one-off prompt effort for upfront data work, and it pays off when the same behavior must repeat reliably.
